# SQL Patterns: mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live

## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- Standard partition filter (most common pattern)
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')

-- Date range: 7-day window
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${PREV_7D}') AND date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'

-- Date range: 30-day window
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${PREV_30D}') AND date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'

-- Date range: 90-day window (used in dws_advertiser_trd_order_gmv_nd)
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN (DATE('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 89 DAYS) AND DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')

-- Month-to-date (used in dim_shop_info_monthly key_seller percentile)
WHERE grass_date >= date(date_trunc('month', '${grass_date}'))
  AND grass_date <= '${grass_date}'
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'

-- Row-level filter: positive GMV items only
AND gmv_usd_1d > 0

-- Row-level filter: items with orders
AND placed_order_cnt_1d > 0

-- Exclude campaign/double days (voucher uplift workflow)
AND month(grass_date) != dayofmonth(grass_date)
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- Pattern 1: JOIN with ads_advertise_mkt_1d on item_id + grass_date (ROI2 key metrics)
LEFT JOIN platform_item_gmv
  ON ads.item_id = platform_item_gmv.item_id
  AND ads.grass_date = platform_item_gmv.grass_date

-- Pattern 2: JOIN with ads_advertise_mkt_1d on item_id only (competitiveness)
LEFT JOIN item_gmv
  ON item_rank.item_id = item_gmv.item_id

-- Pattern 3: JOIN with dws_seller_gmv_1d on shop_id + grass_date + grass_region (order aggregation)
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT shop_id, grass_date, grass_region, sum(placed_order_cnt_1d) AS item_amount_1d
    FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
    ...
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
) b ON a.shop_id = b.shop_id AND a.grass_date = b.grass_date AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region

-- Pattern 4: JOIN with ads item data on item_id (diagnosis CR calculation)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT item_id, shop_id, sum(placed_order_cnt_1d) AS platform_order_cnt_30d
    FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
    ...
    GROUP BY 1, 2
) c ON a.item_id = c.item_id
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- Item-level daily GMV (most common, used in ROI2 window calculation)
SELECT item_id, grass_date,
    sum(gmv_usd_1d) AS gmv_usd,
    sum(paid_order_cnt_1d) AS order_cnt
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
GROUP BY 1, 2

-- Shop-level daily GMV (used in seller metrics, shop GMV max)
SELECT shop_id, grass_date,
    sum(gmv_1d) AS platform_gmv_1d
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
GROUP BY 1, 2

-- Shop-level MTD GMV with percentile (key_seller_90/95 classification)
SELECT shop_id, sum(gmv_usd_1d) AS platform_gmv_usd
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date >= date(date_trunc('month', '${grass_date}'))
GROUP BY shop_id
-- then: PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY shop_level1_category ORDER BY platform_gmv_usd)

-- Item-level 30-day order count (ROI2 bidding strategy, long-tail product detection)
SELECT item_id, shop_id,
    sum(placed_order_cnt_1d) AS platform_order_cnt_30d
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${PREV_30D}') AND date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
GROUP BY 1, 2

-- Item-level 7-day GMV (competitiveness scoring)
SELECT item_id, sum(gmv_usd_1d) AS last_7d_gmv
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date >= DATE_SUB(DATE('${grass_date}'), 6)
GROUP BY item_id

-- Shop-level 7-day local GMV (voucher uplift, excluding double days)
SELECT shop_id, sum(gmv_1d) AS platform_gmv_local_7d
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${PREV_7D}') AND date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  AND month(grass_date) != dayofmonth(grass_date)
GROUP BY shop_id

-- Shop-level N-day aggregation with window flags (90-day trade order report)
SELECT shop_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN placed_order_cnt_1d ELSE 0 END) AS order_cnt_1d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_7d = 1 THEN placed_order_cnt_1d ELSE 0 END) AS order_cnt_7d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_30d = 1 THEN placed_order_cnt_1d ELSE 0 END) AS order_cnt_30d,
    ...
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
GROUP BY shop_id

-- Seller-level weekly metrics (QSS performance)
SELECT shop_id, grass_region,
    sum(placed_order_cnt_1d) AS seller_orders,
    sum(gmv_usd_1d) AS seller_gmv
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING sum(placed_order_cnt_1d) >= 1

-- Item-level single-day order count (discovery ads target CIR)
SELECT item_id, coalesce(placed_order_cnt_1d, 0) AS placed_order_cnt_1d
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = '${grass_date}'

-- Item-level 30-day + single-day conditional aggregation (diagnosis CR)
SELECT item_id, shop_id,
    sum(placed_order_cnt_1d) AS platform_order_cnt_30d,
    sum(if(grass_date = date'${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', placed_order_cnt_1d, null)) AS platform_order_cnt_1d
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${PREV_30D}') AND date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
GROUP BY 1, 2
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: ROI2 Item Key Metrics -- Platform GMV Window (7d/14d)

```sql
-- Source: workflows/.../ads_item_roi2_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live
create or replace temporary view platform_item_gmv as (
    select
        item_id, grass_date,
        sum(gmv_usd_1d) as gmv_usd,
        sum(paid_order_cnt_1d) as order_cnt
    from mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
    where grass_date between date('${PREV_21D}') and date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
      and grass_region = upper('${region}')
      and tz_type = 'local'
      and gmv_usd_1d > 0
    group by 1, 2
);
-- Used downstream for: platform_gmv_w7d, platform_gmv_max7d, platform_gmv_med7d (percentile)
```

### Snippet 2: Ads Diagnosis -- Platform Order for CR Calculation

```sql
-- Source: workflows/.../ads_sc_ads_diagnosis_campaign_daily__reg_s0_live
select item_id, shop_id,
    sum(placed_order_cnt_1d) as platform_order_cnt_30d,
    sum(if(grass_date = date'${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', placed_order_cnt_1d, null)) platform_order_cnt_1d
from mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
where grass_region = upper('${region}')
  and tz_type = 'local'
  and grass_date between date('${PREV_30D}') and date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  and placed_order_cnt_1d > 0
group by 1, 2
-- Joined to compute: CR = platform_order_cnt / platform_click_cnt
```

### Snippet 6: Shop GMV Max Budget -- 30-Day Average Platform GMV

```sql
-- Source: workflows/.../ads_indexer_shop_gmv_max_shop_budget__reg_s0_live
select shop_id, avg(platform_gmv_1d) as l30d_daily_platform_gmv
from (
    select shop_id, grass_date, sum(gmv_1d) as platform_gmv_1d
    from mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
    where grass_region = upper('${region}')
      and tz_type = 'local'
      and grass_date between date('${PREV_30D}') and date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
      and grass_date not in (select campaign_day from dim_campaign_day)
      and gmv_usd_1d > 0
    group by 1, 2
) group by 1
-- Budget formula: greatest(l30d_daily_revenue, l30d_daily_platform_gmv * 0.05) / l7d_daily_budget_usage
```

### Snippet 7: Seller Weekly QSS Performance -- Multi-Region

```sql

select shop_id, grass_region,
    sum(placed_order_cnt_1d) AS seller_orders,
    sum(gmv_usd_1d) as seller_gmv
from mp_order.dws_item_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
where grass_date BETWEEN ... - interval '7' day AND ...
  and grass_region in ('VN','PH','TH','TW','MY','SG','ID','BR')
```


## Derived Metrics

| Metric | Formula | Appears In |
|--------|---------|------------|
| Platform GMV (USD, item-day) | `sum(gmv_usd_1d)` | ROI2 key metrics, seller metrics, competitiveness |
| Platform GMV (local, item-day) | `sum(gmv_1d)` | Shop GMV Max, voucher uplift |
| Platform Order Count | `sum(placed_order_cnt_1d)` | ROI2 bidding, diagnosis CR, QSS, trade order |
| Conversion Rate (CR) | `platform_order_cnt / platform_click_cnt` | Ads diagnosis (joined with traffic data) |
| Key Seller P90/P95 | `PERCENT_RANK() OVER (... ORDER BY sum(gmv_usd_1d))` | dim_shop_info_monthly |
| Budget Formula | `greatest(revenue, platform_gmv * 0.05) / budget_usage` | Shop GMV Max budget |
| 30-Day Avg Daily Platform GMV | `avg(sum(gmv_1d) per day)` excl. campaign days | Shop GMV Max budget |
